Quick legal read and recommended compromise (inline):

- Notice window: we can accept 60 days for standard order forms. Language: "Either party may give written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the then-current Term's expiration."

- Term & auto-renew: recommend 12-month renewal periods with auto-renew unless notice is provided. Language: "The Initial Term shall be twelve (12) months. Thereafter the Agreement will automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party provides the notice required above."

- Termination for convenience (TFC): we can agree to mutual TFC with pro-rated refund of pre-paid and unused fees, subject to a termination fee for orders with committed reserved capacity. Language: "Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' written notice. If Customer terminates for convenience, Customer will receive a pro-rata refund of pre-paid, unused fees, except for any fees related to reserved capacity or committed usage, which shall be subject to the Reserved Commitment Termination Fee in the Order Form."

- Pilot carveout: approve a one-time carveout limited to first Term only, up to thirty (30) days, applicable to pilots under $100k TCV and not for Reserved Capacity. Language: "Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may elect a one-time pilot opt-out during the first Term by providing no less than thirty (30) days' written notice prior to renewal; this carveout is limited to pilots with total contract value less than $100,000 and does not apply to Reserved Capacity commitments."

Operational notes: offboarding deliverables (data handover, KV cache purge, final logs) will be covered by the attached playbook; we should reference that playbook in the SOW/Order Form as an operational exhibit.

I'll turn this into a tracked redline tonight and send to Jordan.

—Karthik
Head of Legal (contracts review)
Redwood Inference

If Fletcher can confirm acceptance of the pilot carveout and the reserved-capacity exception, we will prepare the DocuSign envelope and aim for signature by 9/7. DocuSign link (prepped): https://app.docusign.com/some-fletcher-envelope-id
